implementation_summary: Wrote ADR 0036 (Accepted, 2026-11-03, D-003/Q-50 answer 'adopt'). Hosted Website Audit data lives in a Cloud Storage always-free bucket in us-central1, enabled by AUDIT_STORE_BUCKET; local runs keep <RUNNER_DATA_DIR>/audit-store/. One folder per Website Audit and version. Only the runner's service account can reach the bucket (role on that bucket only, uniform bucket-level access, public access prevention, no signed URLs). Q-30 retention: kept until the tool user deletes the Website Audit; deleting removes every version, edit, file, Shortlist entry, Shared Link and snapshot, and Helper grant; versioning and soft delete are off. Shared Links have unguessable IDs, point to a snapshot, expire after 30 days and can be revoked. /s/:linkId is a runner route with access level public in the route table (BE-102), GET only; 404 for unknown or badly formed IDs, 410 when expired, revoked or deleted; reads only the shared snapshot; noindex, no-referrer, no-store, nosniff, strict CSP (default-src 'none', no script). Records the $0 hosting vs /tmp (AR-09) trade-off and the Q-39/Q-50 tension, with alternatives. ADR 0036 names ADR 0032 as amended, and a back-link line was added to ADR 0032. Added a docs contract test for the required content.
tests_proposed: BE-604 integration: /s/:linkId returns 410 for expired/revoked/deleted links, 404 for malformed IDs, and sets X-Robots-Tag noindex plus the ADR's CSP header
Store test: deleting a Website Audit removes its Shared Link index entries
risks: Free-tier figure (5 GB of Standard storage a month in us-central1) is from my own knowledge, not checked against current Google pricing.
Details I chose that the task did not name (exact CSP string, header set, soft delete off, Shared Link index outside the audit's folder) bind BE-600/601/604 and the deploy task.
ADR 0033 names 0037 'helper sign-in' while the plan uses 0037 for route access levels; ADR 0036 does not cite 0037.
The Avoid-word test checks a chosen subset; generic words (run, user, project) are left out because CONTEXT.md uses them in other senses.
handoff: Website Audit store tasks (BE-600, BE-601, BE-604, the deploy/DEPLOYMENT.md task) should depend on DOC-104 (AC-2, checked by the orchestrator at merge). BE-604 must set the ADR's /s/:linkId headers and status codes (404 unknown or malformed, 410 expired/revoked/deleted, noindex, no-store, no-referrer, nosniff, CSP default-src 'none') and read only the shared snapshot. The deploy task must create the bucket in us-central1 with versioning off, soft delete off (0 days), uniform bucket-level access and public access prevention, grant the runner's service account a role on that bucket only, and pass AUDIT_STORE_BUCKET to Cloud Run.
